designationHistory.indexText: President Obama established Río Grande del Norte National Monument in New Mexico by proclamation under the Antiquities Act.
designationHistory.note: Published in the Federal Register March 28, 2013. Some secondary listings mis-cite it as 78 FR 18777, which is Proclamation 8945.

sources.name: 54 U.S.C. 320301 notes, national monuments list (Cornell LII)
